_about: Gilbert Murray (1866-1957), Regius Professor of Greek at Oxford. His verse translations of the Greek plays are on the euripides, aeschylus and sophocles shelves and his Poetics on aristotle; this shelf holds his own scholarship. He died in 1957, but every book here was published before 1930. Project Gutenberg: Five Stages of Greek Religion; Euripides and His Age. Raw IA OCR: A History of Ancient Greek Literature (Heinemann; first impression 1897, this the impression of 1911); The Rise of the Greek Epic (Oxford, 1907); The Interpretation of Ancient Greek Literature, inaugural lecture (Oxford, 1909); Tradition and Progress (Houghton Mifflin, 1922). Held: The Classical Tradition in Poetry (1927); one scan is a 1957 Vintage reprint and the other's imprint year is cut off after 'MCMXXX'. His surname is common, so only the full name is used. US public domain. No uids minted. Round dx (2026-10-23) added: Andromache, a play in three acts (clean Gutenberg, PG 38909), and raw IA OCR with title pages read: The Frogs of Aristophanes in English verse (Allen, 1908); The Story of Nefrekepta from a demotic papyrus (Clarendon Press, 1911); What English Poetry may still learn from Greek (Clarendon Press, 1912); Hamlet and Orestes (Oxford University Press, 1914); The Stoic Philosophy (Watts; Allen and Unwin, 1915); Religio Grammatici (Houghton Mifflin, 1918); Aristophanes and the War Party (Allen and Unwin, 1919); Our Great War and the Great War of the Ancient Greeks (New York: Seltzer, 1920); Essays and Addresses (Allen and Unwin, 1921); The Classical Tradition in Poetry (Oxford University Press, 1927). His Euripides, Sophocles and Aeschylus translations are on those shelves; his war and League of Nations pamphlets are outside lane B's brief.
